prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one realistic cinematic literary illustration for Nahum 2:3–8, landscape 3:2, requested 1536x1024.

One coherent, non-graphic siege image from Nahum's poetic oracle. At a generic town gate, the gate has swung open as river water surges through the entrance. A single chariot moves through the shallow water nearby; two or three defenders hurry back toward the gate. Show disruption and retreat, not hand-to-hand fighting. Keep the open gate, the one chariot, and the retreating defenders as the readable foreground subjects. No second chariot, no other vehicles, no named ruler or specific city.

Composition: confine the gate, walls, chariot, defenders, water action and all visible objects and people to x=5–57%. Gate around x=23%, chariot around x=40%, retreating figures around x=33%. Reserve x=62–100% as calm low-detail river edge, open plain, and pale sky for reader overlay; x=57–62% is an empty buffer. No people, vehicles, buildings, or dramatic splash beyond x=57%. Top and bottom 12% noncritical. One continuous episode, no montage. Do not extend a busy city or battle scene into the right third.

Setting: generic ancient Near Eastern town edge; no specific wall design, landmark, archaeological reconstruction, verified attack route, modern boundary, or map. Use simple weathered stonework only. Warm late-afternoon earth tones with muted iron red, dusty olive, limestone, and restrained water reflections. Realistic cinematic historical/literary painting matching supplied Bible illustration references, tactile wood, stone, wheels, and water. Tense but restrained.

This illustrates the oracle's siege language and description of Nineveh's defenses failing. It does not claim a precise reconstruction of ancient Nineveh or identify one historical attack path. Keep violence non-graphic and show no bodies. No deity or divine human figure.

Avoid: text, letters, captions, labels, names, verse numbers, pins, UI, logos, watermark, maps, route lines, modern objects, recognizable monuments, extra chariots or vehicles, detailed architecture on right, dramatic water on right, gore, corpses, burning city, graphic violence, cruelty, deity, halo, magical spectacle, or crowded battle.
notes: Final raster reviewed against the named subjects; account-specific references remain in the scene registry. Historical appearances are reconstructed and literary scenes are labeled.
